name: Parse string (SSR → fields)
description: Split a packed string — e.g. an SSR like "SSR BIKE P1 F OVERSIZE" or "INFT P1" — into named tokens using a friendly {token} pattern (no regex), then map those tokens onto a saved Asset's fields. Emits the asset with its values filled from the parsed string.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The string field to parse, e.g. $.ssr.

inputs.name: asset
inputs.description: The output to fill from the parsed tokens — a saved Asset (product) or an output Template (a shape like Passenger).

params.name: pattern
params.description: Friendly {token} pattern. The literal text between {tokens} are the delimiters, e.g. {ssr} {type} {paxRef} {class} {detail}.

params.name: mapping
params.description: Maps each {token} to a field on the asset, e.g. { "type": "code", "detail": "label" }.
